questions.question: 「树」的英文是（　）
「湖上有一条船。」的英文是（　）
options: There is a boat on the lake.
There are a boat on the lake.
There have a boat on the lake.
questions.answer: There is a boat on the lake.

questions.question: 「公园里有很多树。」的英文是（　）
options: There are trees in the park.
There is trees in the park.
There are tree in the park.
There have trees in the park.
questions.answer: There are trees in the park.

questions.question: There is 后面跟单数名词，There are 跟复数。

knowledge_summary.point: 景物词汇 lake / boat / tree / grass / hill / flower
knowledge_summary.core_concept: lake 湖、boat 小船、tree 树、grass 草、hill 小山、flower 花。tree 复数是 trees。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: lake / boat / tree / grass / hill / flower

knowledge_summary.core_concept: There is a boat on the lake. 湖上有一条船。There are trees in the park. 公园里有很多树。单数用 is，复数用 are。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: There is a + 单数 / There are + 复数
